The state of UK commercial EV charging installers

Updated 2026-05-19 · derived from official GOV.UK / OZEV data (OGL v3.0)

This is the picture the official OZEV tool doesn't give you: how many authorised commercial & fleet EV charger installers operate in the UK, and how unevenly they're spread.

Latest refresh (2026-05-18): +134 added, −3 removed since the previous update. The dataset rebuilds weekly.

1132OZEV commercial installers
12UK regions covered
272towns with ≥1 installer
56%have a working website

Installers by region

Installers per million people (the real coverage picture)

Raw counts favour big regions. Per-capita density shows where commercial EV buyers actually have the least choice — the “installer deserts”.
